reviews.title: Great Value and Reliable Drives
reviews.comment: I bought 4 of these 4TB drives and all arrived with very low run times. Installed them in my NAS and they’ve been running for a couple of months now with no issues. Great price, solid product, and the added warranty makes it even better.
reviews.author: Jose Guantes

reviews.title: Works great and compatible with Windows 11 requirements.
reviews.comment: I discovered that my issue with upgrading to Windows 11 was simply that it didn't like the older hard drive I had.  I replaced it and transferred everything over.  Then I was able to install Windows 11.  This was a "renewed" product that was offered at a great price.  It has been working for several months now without issue.  Very satisfied.
reviews.author: Andy B
